title: Focused update of the saved heat comparison through Wright
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Heat-spreader comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved heat-spreader workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Continue exact test review
manualSteps.instruction: Inspect the labelled synthetic test review. Check I reviewed this action and its evidence, then click Continue process.

steps.label: Reopen existing built preview
steps.summary: Recover the exact already generated preview in the workspace.
steps.purpose: Recover the saved job without generation or model replay.
steps.expected: Exact existing read-only preview connected with recorded heat results.
steps.actual: Existing preview connected; 18 result cards visible.

steps.label: Save existing preview
steps.summary: Retain the exact previewed build with its binding and provenance.
steps.purpose: Complete the existing job without another model call.

steps.label: Open saved existing revision
steps.summary: The recovered built interface opens in a Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Use the same saved compiled build.
steps.expected: Saved interface connects to the same heat run.
steps.actual: Saved interface connected with 18 results and Wright styling.
